name: South Korea
administering_agency: Ministry of Justice; run by the Korea Immigration Foundation (한국이민재단)

format.notes: Written part, 40 items in 60 minutes: 36 multiple choice (65 points) and 4 short writing items (10 points). Oral part, 5 items in 10 minutes (25 points). 60 points of 100 to pass.

notes: Read from the test provider’s guide, which sets out the permanent-residence and naturalization evaluations side by side; the table read may describe both. The nationality law itself was not read.
